entries.name: Sandbox-only constraint
entries.summary: This shared brain is a tech demo. Do not modify live Notion pages, ship to production, or treat these rows as real product memory.

entries.name: What the preview board should show
entries.summary: The preview board should show a timeline of which agent wrote what and when, plus a clear handoff pickup from one agent to another.

entries.name: Snapshot fallback if no Notion token
entries.summary: If the deployed preview has no Notion API token, serve a static snapshot JSON of the seeded entries exported at build time, and label the board as a snapshot.

entries.name: Preview deploy only
entries.summary: The companion board deploys as a Vercel preview only. Do not run a production deploy or use vercel --prod.

entries.name: Use a fictional Harbor Lights story
entries.summary: All demo copy uses a fictional Harbor Lights launch. Do not put live product data, customer records, or secrets in this sandbox.

entries.name: Three memory databases
entries.summary: Keep shared memory in three small databases: Context for durable facts, Decisions for choices later agents should honor, and Handoffs for work passed between agents.

entries.name: Review Harbor Lights timeline UI
entries.summary: The Harbor Lights preview board is ready for review. Please confirm the timeline shows each agent's entries and that the handoff pickup badge is visible.

entries.name: Export snapshot JSON for the board
entries.summary: If the preview cannot use a Notion API token, export the seeded Context, Decisions, and Handoffs rows to a static snapshot JSON at build time.
